criteria.statement: The five example commands in the success line get the verdict the line states.
No command that the four gates blocked before the rewrite passes after it.

domain.row: A row is one command with its verdict before the rewrite and the verdict required after it; the spec owner adds a row in a new revision.

criteria.statement: An argument is released as data only when its shape is in the release list, and no released shape is an interpreter body.

construction.invariant: No entry of the release list is a body an interpreter would execute.

checks.condition: Every entry of the release list is one finite argument shape with a case in the corpus, and none is a body an interpreter would execute.

criteria.statement: A block message names the action the command performs, not the text the gate matched.

checks.condition: A reader of the block message can say which action was refused without seeing the matched text.
